question.text: Let <math><mi>f</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>-</mo><mo>|</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>|</mo></math> and <math><mi>g</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo></math> <math><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mo>∈</mo><mi> </mi><mi>R</mi><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mi>f</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></math> attains maximum value at <math><mi>α</mi></math> and <math><mi>g</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></math> attains minimum value at <math><mi>β</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then <math><munder><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>-</mo><mi>α</mi><mi>β</mi></mrow></munder><mfrac><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Maxima of fx will occur at x=2 i.e., α=2

Minima of g(x) will occur at x=-1 i.e. β=-1

∴ limx→2(x-1)(x-2)(x-3)(x-2)(x-4)=12.
